newsitem.title: USA: Men's Wearhouse in Kuppenheimer venture.
newsitem.headline: Men's Wearhouse in Kuppenheimer venture.

text.p: Men's Wearhouse Inc said Tuesday it had formed a joint venture with Buxbaum, Ginsberg & Associates and had agreed to acquire and liquidate certain assets of Kuppenheimer's Men's Clothiers.

Kuppenheimer's is a chain of 43 men's clothing stores. Kuppenheimer Manufacturing Co Inc has been operating under Chapter 11 proceedings since August 1996. Since then, Kuppenheimer's has closed about 40 stores.
The majority of the remaining Kuppenheimer's stores are located in Chicago, Atlanta and St. Louis.
The joint venture will operate a Kuppenheimer's going-out-of business sale under the agreement.
Men's Wearhouse has entered into an agreement to obtain the rights to the tradename, customer list, certain fixed assets and other proprietary information of Kuppenheimer's.
In addition, Men's Wearhouse has an option to review all existing Kuppenheimer store locations and ascertain if it will assume any of the existing leases.
The joint venture will be managed by Paul Buxbaum of Buxbaum, Ginsberg & Associates. Buxbaum has more than 20 years of experience in the retail liquidation business.
Men's Wearhouse is one of the largest U.S. off-price specialty retailers of men's tailored business attire.
